fam_way-be186ab1c0a4.line: Starting bare-faced, each makeup and styling step jumps an on-screen percentage counter up on the beat until reaching a 100% full-glam reveal.

open.label: 100% to 0% takedown
open.what: Run the percentage counter backward from 100% full glam down to 0% bare-faced in a sheet mask.
open.how: Start in full makeup at 100% and cut on each beat as lashes, lip tint, and base come off until the bar hits 0%.

open.label: smudge drops percentage
open.what: A mascara or eyeliner smudge at 90% knocks the progress bar back down before recovering to 100%.
open.how: Step the bar up to 90%, freeze on an eyeliner slip as the counter drops to 40%, then cut to the fixed 100% look.

open.label: 99% cancel and stay home
open.what: Build the makeup counter up to 99%, then a canceled-plans text drops it straight back to 0% in pajamas.
open.how: Cut through every makeup step to 99%, flash a cancellation message on screen, and drop to 0% in a hair roller.

fam_cur-80ca955b9370.line: Show the sequential stages of a hair routine from messy hair to the finished style.

open.label: split-screen products
open.what: Style the left and right halves of the back of the head with two different routines across the cuts
open.how: Part wet hair down the middle from behind, apply air-dry cream to one side and blow-dry the other across matching cuts

open.label: humidity ruins mythic
open.what: Build perfect curls up to the legendary tier, then step outside into humidity for a frizzy mythic tier.
open.how: Cut through each styling step indoors, then film the final tier callout outside with brushed-out frizzy hair.

open.label: reverse washday
open.what: Start in full glamorous hair and makeup at rare tier and strip away layers down to a bare face and bonnet.
open.how: Film in reverse order from full glam to removing hair clips, wiping makeup, and putting on a satin bonnet.

fam_cur-6cedd3c94ec9.line: They dance barefaced before transitioning into a fully styled glam look with a hand gesture.

open.label: makeup fail
open.what: The hand swipe reveals an exaggerated, messy makeup fail instead of glamorous perfection.
open.how: Swipe the hand to cut into smeared clownish lipstick, wonky eyeliner, and bewildered acting.

open.label: partner swap
open.what: The person swiping stays bare-faced while their partner behind them transforms into full glam.
open.how: Swipe on your tired face, but reveal yourself unchanged while your partner behind poses cute.

open.label: reverse glam
open.what: Instead of turning glamorous, the swipe cuts to an even messier bedtime look with a sheet mask.
open.how: Swipe forward expecting glam, then reveal yourself in an awkward sheet mask and oversized glasses.

fam_cur-12194faefdb2.line: The camera frames walking feet first before tilting up to reveal the full outfit.

open.label: pajama top half
open.what: Walk in full spooky boots and gothic skirt, then tilt up to cozy flannel pajamas and a sleep mask.
open.how: Pair dramatic platform boots and a long dark skirt with a messy bun, a skincare sheet mask, and a bathrobe on top.

open.label: stilt legs reveal
open.what: Start on the shoes under a floor-length gown and tilt up for an impossibly long time on stilts.
open.how: Stand on stilts or a hidden curb under an extra-long cloak so the upward tilt takes the entire verse before the face.

open.label: crouching cameraperson
open.what: Instead of tilting up to the walker's face, pan around to show the friend crab-walking backward.
open.how: Start on the heels on the dark street, then flip the camera around on the beat to reveal the crouched operator.

fam_cur-a33c844464d0.line: A person lying on the floor switches outfits each time a rotating ceiling fan blade passes over the view.

open.label: ceiling rig reveal
open.what: Show the chaotic reality of taping a phone to the ceiling above a spinning fan to get the shot.
open.how: Start with 3 fan-blade outfit cuts, then cut to a wide side angle showing the creator climbing a ladder to rescue the phone.

open.label: fan speeds up
open.what: Click the fan speed from low to high so the blade wipes and outfit changes accelerate frantically.
open.how: Press the remote to speed up the fan and shorten the clips between blade wipes until outfits flash by every few frames.

open.label: room decor wipe
open.what: Keep the same pajamas on while each passing fan blade changes the rug, bedding, and floor items.
open.how: Lie completely still in the same spot and swap the rug, pillows, and props around your body between each blade pass.
